title.en: Meaning and need of business finance

body.en: Business finance means the funds required for carrying out business activities. Every business needs fixed capital to buy fixed assets such as land, building and machinery, and working capital to meet day-to-day expenses such as raw materials, wages and rent. Funds are also needed for growth, modernisation and expansion.
body.kn: ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಹಣಕಾಸು ಎಂದರೆ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ನಡೆಸಲು ಬೇಕಾದ ಹಣ: ಆಸ್ತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸ್ಥಿರ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮತ್ತು ದೈನಂದಿನ ವೆಚ್ಚಕ್ಕೆ ದುಡಿಯುವ ಬಂಡವಾಳ.

narration.en: Business finance is the money needed to run a business: fixed capital for assets and working capital for daily expenses.
narration.kn: ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಹಣಕಾಸು ಎಂದರೆ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ನಡೆಸಲು ಬೇಕಾದ ಹಣ: ಆಸ್ತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸ್ಥಿರ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮತ್ತು ದೈನಂದಿನ ವೆಚ್ಚಕ್ಕೆ ದುಡಿಯುವ ಬಂಡವಾಳ.

body.en: By period: long-term (more than five years), medium-term (more than one year but less than five years) and short-term (up to one year). By ownership: owners' funds, such as equity shares and retained earnings, and borrowed funds, such as debentures, loans and public deposits. By source of generation: internal sources, generated within the business (retained earnings, collecting receivables, disposing of surplus inventory), and external sources from outside (shares, debentures, banks, trade credit).
body.kn: ಮೂಲಗಳನ್ನು ಅವಧಿ, ಒಡೆತನ ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ಪತ್ತಿಯ ಮೂಲದ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ ವರ್ಗೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Up to 1 year is short-term, 1 to 5 years is medium-term, and beyond 5 years is long-term. Draw a number line: 0 —1— 5 —→.

mnemonic.en: One and Five split Short, Medium, Long

narration.en: Just remember the numbers one and five. Up to one year is short term, one to five years is medium term, and more than five years is long term.

problem.en: Classify by period and by ownership: (a) ₹20 lakh bank loan for 3 years, (b) issue of equity shares, (c) 60 days' credit from a supplier.

steps.en: (a) 3 years lies between 1 and 5 years: medium-term; it is a loan, so borrowed funds.
(b) Equity shares are permanent capital: long-term; they are owners' funds.
(c) 60 days is less than a year: short-term; supplier credit is borrowed (external) funds.

answer.en: (a) Medium-term, borrowed; (b) Long-term, owners' funds; (c) Short-term, borrowed.
